Orchestra and Choir of Teatro Reale dell’Opera di Roma; conductor unidentified Disputed: sources disagree

The current description names Rome, but the original upload-history description named the Teatro La Scala Orchestra and Choir. No conductor is identified. Neither attribution is silently resolved.
